simple.meaning: יְטוּר (Yᵉṭûwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jetur , a son of Ishmael.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְטוּר (H3195) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:15, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְטוּר (H3195) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְטוּר (H3195) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְטוּר (Yᵉṭûwr) / H3195 is traced through Genesis 25:15, 1 Chronicles 1:31, 1 Chronicles 5:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3195. Yetur יְטוּר proper name, masculine and of a people (perhaps connected etymologically with טִירָה see Gen 25:16 ) — a 'son' of Ishmael 25:15 = 1Chr 1:31 +? 5:19 ; Ἰτουραῖοί τε καὶ Ἄραβες Strabo xvi, 2, 18, Ἰτουραίους Joseph Ant. xiii. 11 , 3 ed. Niese; they gave name to their region, which was, substantially, Anti-Lebanon, compare τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας Luke 3:1 ; on יְטוּר and (later) proper name, of a territory Ituraea , see especially GASm Geogr. 544 ff. and reff . מוֺתָר noun masculine Prov 14:23 abundance, pre-eminence ; — 1 abundance, plenty מוֺתָ֑ר Prov 14:23 ; 21:5 (in both opposed to מַחְסוֺר ). 2 pre-eminence, superiority , אָ֔יִן מִןהַֿבְּהֵמָה הָאָדָם מוֺתַר Eccl 3:19 the superiority of man over beast is nothing.
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 2905 ; encircled (i.e. inclosed);

occurrences.englishText: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
